# Joe Heffer

> Senior Research Data Engineer at the University of Sheffield (IT Services), and physicist by background. Builds research software and data pipelines across health, environmental, and genomic data, with a focus on FAIR principles, reproducible workflows, and the responsible use of AI/ML in research.

This is a personal CV and portfolio site at https://heffer.info/. It is a single static HTML page — no login, no client-side rendering required to read the content. Section anchors below link into that page.

## Profile

- [About](https://heffer.info/#about): Background, current focus, and toolkit (Python, R, SQL, Linux, Git, AI/ML, data pipelines, HPC).
- [Experience](https://heffer.info/#experience): Career timeline — Senior Research Data Engineer at Sheffield (2020–present), Analytics Developer in financial services (2017–2020), PhD in Physics at Liverpool (2013–2017, atom interferometry), MPhys at Manchester (2008–2013).
- [CV (PDF)](https://heffer.info/assets/cv.pdf): Downloadable CV.

## Selected projects

- [SORT Online](https://casestudiesrcg.blogspot.com/2026/02/supporting-nhs-research-readiness-with.html): Platform built with NHS England for healthcare organisations to self-assess research readiness.
- [FAIR² for Research Software](https://fair2-for-research-software.github.io/Documentation/): Training course on documenting research software.
- [Music AI task scheduling](https://casestudiesrcg.blogspot.com/2022/11/asynchronous-task-scheduling-for-music.html): Async ML task scheduling for a music-generation web app (Svelte, Django REST Framework, Celery).
- [Urban Flows Observatory](https://github.com/urban-flows/data-logger-server): Data engineering for a citywide environmental sensor network.
- [AIRBODS](https://casestudiesrcg.blogspot.com/2021/11/supporting-airborne-infection-research.html): Data pipelines for airborne SARS-CoV-2 transmission research.
- [CUREd+ Research Database](https://n8cir.org.uk/case-studies/research-data-steward/joe-heffer/): Linked NHS hospital, mental health and ambulance service records.
- [COG-UK genomics pipeline](https://casestudiesrcg.blogspot.com/2021/02/coronavirus-pandemic-helping-national.html): Software architecture and testing for a SARS-CoV-2 Nanopore sequencing pipeline.

## AI & research community

- [AI for Research Day 2026](https://sites.google.com/sheffield.ac.uk/ai-research-day/): Programme lead for the Centre for Machine Intelligence's annual conference.
- [Data Director Agentic AI Blueprint](https://www.rd-alliance.org/groups/data-director-agentic-ai-blueprint/activity/): Research Data Alliance working group on agentic AI for FAIR data management.
- [Research Agents Reading Group](https://github.com/EdwinB12/Agents-Reading-Group): Fortnightly reading group on agentic AI tools and research.
- [Shef.AI community profile](https://shef-ai.github.io/single-profile.html?user=joe-heffer): Sheffield AI community profile.
